notes.title: v1.3.4 fishing & bigpit arena
notes.content:
[h1]v1.3.4 fishing & bigpit arena[/h1]
new in this update is fishing. you can catch fish with a fishing rod in certain areas. fish are consumable items that have various effects.
you will also level up your fishing "talent" while doing so. I didn't make any other talents yet, so for now this is the only one.
Leveling your fishing will make it easier to fish.

the other new thing is Bigpit Arena, a gauntlet that keeps spawning stronger and stronger enemies. you need a ticket to get in and when you do,
you take your entire party (if you have one) with you, if they're in the same area as you.
Bigpit Arena is very tough and meant as a place for the strongest players to challenge themselves and gather a lot of xp.
right now the tickets can be collect in 3 different ways:
- bought for 5 million coins each
- 1 in 10.000 chance drop from any enemy that isn't spawned (so no summon and no cut worms)
- 1 is dropped from the mechanical behemoth if it has <50% health left and an additional one if it was defeated

furthermore i added some content to medio city, it is still not done, but there is some new gear, areas and npcs

[h2]new[/h2]
- new weapon fishing rod, which you can buy from Ray at the pond near the farm
- many different fish
- new area 'calm pond' next to the farm

[h2]changes/balancing[/h2]
- increased kreuzblade base damage from 28 -> 40

notes.title: v1.3.1, new city, auto-attack, runes and more!
notes.content:
[h1]v1.3.1[/h1]

There are 4 new things this update: a new city, auto attacking, changes to buffs/effects and the addition of runes

[h3]New city (Medio)[/h3]
The new city is called Medio, it was technically already in the game, although unreachable.
Medio is not done yet, so there is not much to do yet there.

[h3]Auto attacking[/h3]
There is now a new basic skill called 'attack'. you can use it to start auto attacking a target. this is a huge change to how combat works, because you now won't have to spam "punch mike" anymore.
Each weapon has its own command it uses for auto attacking. 'slash' for slashing weapons, 'stab' for piercing, 'whack' for blunt and 'magic bolt' for magic weapons. Ranged weapons don't have an auto attack,
and will default to 'punch'. Stab is slightly faster and all auto attacks' speed scale with AGI
There is a new area with NPC and a quest in smalltown to learn new players how fighting works.
Hopefully this will help new players have more fun with the game and make the game more accessible for all.

[h3]Buffs/effects[/h3]
This update changes how buffs and effects work in the background. Commands that gave buffs have changed in their scaling and there is new content that give buffs.
You will also be able to see which effects you and your party members currently have with little icons, if you hover over them you can also see how long they'll last.

[h3]Runes[/h3]
Also new in this update are runes. It is a new mechanic for magic wielders. Runes are consumable items that amplify your magic in various ways! 
They're are created with mana and you need a magic weapon to cast them. It is useful to craft them outside of battle with leftover mana, so you can use them in battle later!
A crafted rune has a certain grade, small, medium or great. With better qualities respectively. Chances of crafting better runes scale with your SKL stat.
Recipes for runes are hidden across the chatventures world. There are only 3 now, but more will follow

[h3]and more...[/h3]
I fixed a lot of small stuff and did some balancing. A noticable change is how xp multipliers work for parties.
In short the xp multiplier is now always positive (base mult went up from x0.3 -> x1.0) and works only for party members that are alive and in the same area

notes.title: v1.3.0!
notes.content:
[h3]v1.3.0 is the first of the v1.3 updates planned![/h3]
It introduces a new dungeon: Bigtown Sewers! A filthy place located beneath Bigtown. 
It is a tough maze where you can't use any consumable items, making it very hard to heal. Why are the sewers so filthy and goopy? Maybe we will find out later.

Another new addition in this version are XP items: XP candy, XP cookie, XP donut and XP cake, dropped by boss monsters for now. 
They give you a temporary XP multiplier from defeating enemies.

I also want to quickly talk about bow and arrows- a new weapon type in chatventures. 
They were already available in the previous update from last week and have limited content for now. 
I hope to add more skills and items soon!

notes.title: "Rime Halls" free content update available now!
notes.content:
Big update!

- dungeons! 
dungeons are late game areas that are actually a collection of multiple areas, they are quite big compared to the rest of the game. inside dungeons you can't teleport and you won't heal, so be sure to prepare before entering. moving around in dungeons requires using the commands 'go north', 'go south', 'go west', 'go east' and 'take stairs'.
it is ill-advised to go alone.

- party system!
you can now form a party together with other players! when in a party, you'll split experience gained from defeating enemies as long as you're in the same area. defeating enemies will also level up your 'party level'. higher party levels will unlock more slots for party members and increase experience gained from enemies!

- reforging/upgrading weapons and armor! 
there is a cottage in the plains where you can learn how to reforge equipment.
reforging makes equipment stronger! you can reforge an items 5 times, but you need power stones to do it.
the first upgrade is always a guaranteed success. after that, the chance is 80 -20% for each upgrade level and you can increase the chance with 1% for each power stone used.
power stones can be dropped by any enemy. the droprate depends on your level compared to the enemy's level. chances and drop amount are better for boss enemies.

- prestiging!
in-game it is called 'rebirths'.
when you're lvl100 there is a place where you can go to reset all your progress and start over anew. this process is called 'rebirth'. with every rebirth you gain 10 extra stat points and a star in your profile.
accounts with rebirths will be placed higher on the billboard!
when rebirthing you will lose equipped items (and keep items in your inventory), so be sure to go in naked.

- offhand equipment!
mainly shields and tomes.
this also means some weapons are now two-handed and some weapons are one-handed.
you can only equip offhand items together with one-handed weapons.

- new areas, enemies, items, NPCs, quests, commands, etc.

balancing & changes

- added stat requirements for armor equipment
- upped the max stat cap from 99 -> 199 (except for perception)
- all AOE damage is now halved after damage calculation
- buddy's famous push up challenge now rewards you +3 str permanently instead of +1
- 'scrutinize' mana cost increased from 20 -> 50
- 'heal' mana cost decreased from 25 -> 20
- 'summon' mana cost increased from 50 -> 100
- 'inferno' base damage decreased from 10 -> 1
- 'blizzard' base damage decreased from 30 -> 5
- 'swing weapon' base damage decreased from 10 -> 5
- 'skilldance' mana cost decreased from 35 -> 30
- 'skilldance' now repeat 3 times in stead of 5 times
- crafting 'fairy staff' fairy dust requirement decreased from 15 -> 1
- kill requirement for 'a different perspective' quest decreased from 20 -> 10
- doubled all stats for guards
- shortsword can't use stab anymore
- removed magic damage resistance for 'pantzer'
- changed experience gained per enemy. now based on estimated enemy level.
- nerfed one-handed weapons
- renamed 'wand' to 'simple wand'
- renamed 'pantzer' to 'pantzer vest'
- renamed 'crystal' to 'crystal shard'

fixes

- 'shadow mask' karma power wasn't working
- you can no longer travel to tree house from everywhere
- you can't consume every item anymore
- can't say hello to everyone from everywhere anymore
- can't unequip items that you don't have anymore
- picking up a stack of non-stackable items (like weapons) won't make excess items disappear anymore
- fixed some inventory messages displaying the wrong message/wrong amount of items
- getting money when scrutinizing will no longer get you an item called coins
- getting items from NPCs when you're inventory is full will now drop the items to the floor instead of them disappearing
- when creating a new account you can see your password in the character creation menu more clearly
- pressing escape didn't actually log you off, making it impossible to log back in with the same account without quiting the entire game
- 'punch' damage doesn't increase with weapon damage anymore

misc.

- added an option to disable to wobble in the UI
- enemies now have an estimates level, which is shown when you check an enemy
- added in some kind of anti-macro usage feature.
